name: Hearts on Parole
source:
Welcome to Hearts on Parole, a mostly linear, romantic, plot-driven AVN set in Lone River, a thriving town in good ol' USA. You star as Byron Boldston,  a Probation and Parole Officer haunted by his past of loss. He supervises those on, you guessed it,  probation and parole. Byron will meet many people along the way, some old friends and others new.  Chances for love, pain, and redemption lay on the horizon. Will he embrace these opportunities at the cost of his profession, or turn them down to remain steadfast to his duties and dearly departed? Anything is possible in Lone River. The Office is open, and I invite you to come have some fun.

[From [url=https://magnumstories.itch.io/hearts-on-parole]Itch.io[/url]]
